column1: # title: ACMG carrier Tier 4 (Gregg AR et al., Genet Med 2021, PMC8488021: recessive and X-linked genes beyond Tier 3, chosen by the laboratory), taken here as the recessive-only genes of ClinGen's gene-disease validity curations

# cut: from the export's column row (GENE SYMBOL, ..., MOI, SOP, CLASSIFICATION, ...), the genes with a curation of MOI AR or XL at CLASSIFICATION Definitive or Strong (1,421) and no curation of MOI AD or SD at Definitive, Strong or Moderate (112 such dual-mode genes left out, ATM, PKD1, RYR1 and F5 among them: a gene with a dominant curation keeps its dominant handling); one row per gene, inheritance AR where any qualifying curation is AR, else XL; 1,309 genes (1,160 AR, 149 XL), sorted
# scope: the carrier gate only (genelists.carrier_genes: Tier 3 and Tier 4 together, Tier 3's inheritance winning); not the VUS watch rule, the panel's claims or the structural exon screen
